business_problem: ChargePoint's charging-session data was fragmented across seven systems, resulting in slow queries, infrastructure maintenance overhead, and difficulty scaling analytics as data volumes grew.
solution_summary: ChargePoint consolidated its global EV charging data lake from seven systems onto Snowflake AI Data Cloud running on Google Cloud. The unified Snowflake dataset supports the company's growing charging-session data and provides native access to Gemini models without the latency and cost of moving data across cloud regions. ChargePoint embedded a natural-language Data Assistant in its application for workplace charging administrators, fleet managers, and commercial operators. Gemini Flash and Pro translate questions into data queries, run automated safety checks, and return real-time visualizations so customers can inspect charger uptime, high-traffic locations, and fleet-routing opportunities. The story describes the unified data platform and its application-facing assistant, but does not identify source-system products, ingestion tooling, or the specific query and visualization services.
